rules: Direct color templates and direct how-many templates only; counts 1-6; eleven basic colors, grey->gray.
Lowercase, strip punctuation/articles, normalize nominal-head plural; no synonym or semantic-role merging.
Strip only picture/image/photo context; preserve spatial and attribute restrictions such as on the couch.
Every parsed answer for the same referent and task must agree on one supported answer; conflicting or unsupported labels reject that referent.
Two referents must each have existing color and count questions, with different colors and different counts.
Two-wording coverage requires two distinct normalized original question strings in each of all four cells; duplicated questions do not count.
These are raw candidates, not verified valid materials. Different referents may still name one category; image truth and all study eligibility checks remain outstanding.
Conservative extraction misses valid rephrasings; numbers are lower bounds on text-match coverage, not dataset-wide semantic availability estimates.
